description: Test suite for the AssistantTextParser component, verifying parsing of tagged segments in assistant responses.

classes.name: AssistantTextParserTests
classes.description: A test suite structured for Swift's XCTest framework, testing various parsing behaviors of AssistantTextParser.

methods.name: splitsThinkAndFinalSegments
methods.description: Tests that the parser correctly splits segments marked with <think> and <final> tags.

methods.name: keepsTextWithoutTags
methods.description: Verifies that untagged plain text remains a single response segment.

methods.name: ignoresThinkingLikeTags
methods.description: Ensures that tags similar to <thinking> are ignored and only recognized tags are parsed.

methods.name: dropsEmptyTaggedContent
methods.description: Checks that empty tagged segments like <think></think> are discarded.

methods.name: hidesThinkingSegmentsFromVisibleOutput
methods.description: Confirms that segments marked as 'thinking' are not visible in the output.

methods.name: thinkingOnlyTextIsNotVisibleByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that 'thinking' segments are hidden unless explicitly included.
